walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent animation sprite sheet for a game fan website. Reference image: the existing approved SD Gwen investigate illustration; exactly preserve its chibi proportions, thick dark outline, flat cel shading, navy bob with gold hairclip, half-lidded golden eyes, blue military detective jacket, gold epaulettes, teal ribbon, white frills and gloves. Create Gwen walking in RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, full body, holding a small blank file folder. ONE CHARACTER animation: four sequential walk-cycle frames in a single horizontal strip of FOUR EQUAL CELLS, same scale, same baseline, same fixed head/body location, ample transparent gutters so each cell can be cropped cleanly. Legs alternate front/back and arms swing subtly; face stays calm and inquisitive. All-ages. Absolutely no text, letters, labels, watermark, scenery, ground or shadows. True transparent background. Match the supplied approved SD exactly rather than realistic anatomy. The four cells are animation frames, not four different illustrations.

Use references ONLY for character face, costume and original polished anime painting/cel-shading style, NEVER their backgrounds. NORMAL adult anime proportions, NOT chibi. Golden eyes, small gold bar hairclip, navy bob, blue military jacket, gold fringed epaulettes, teal neck bow with red jewel, white jabot and white gloves. All-ages. A confident reassuring smile and a THUMBS UP near her shoulder for a successful calculation. Frame from crown to waist, face large and readable. Produce TWO matching frames side by side in equal cells with transparent gutters: left eyes open with confident smile; right a playful wink with thumb raised a little. Same face identity, head/body position, scale, silhouette and proportions in both cells. Clean professional 2D game illustration matching reference 22.png and 23.webp, restrained highlights, crisp facial details. Absolutely no text, symbols, logos, captions, speech bubble, background scene or floor shadow. True transparent background; neatly cropped waist edge.
